gate_a.rationale: This is a critical-complexity framework task with high safety stakes. Alignment (0.30) is weighted highest because the solution must precisely follow 8 core decisions (D1-D8), 6 Zone 0 guardrails, and multiple architectural constraints (fractal Loop, heartbeat, file-as-state). Global impact (0.25) is elevated because this framework becomes the foundation for all future autonomous Agent work — any architectural flaw propagates everywhere. Completeness (0.25) ensures all 31 P0 requirements are addressed. Necessity (0.20) prevents over-engineering while maintaining the '一步到位' mandate.

dynamic_checks.name: P0 Requirement Full Coverage
dynamic_checks.description: Every P0 requirement (REQ-001 through REQ-063, all 31 P0 items) must have a corresponding design element in the solution
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Solution maps each P0 REQ to at least one concrete design component, mechanism, or implementation pattern. No P0 requirement is left unaddressed.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: 31 P0 requirements define the minimum viable framework. Missing any P0 means the framework is incomplete and cannot deliver the promised capabilities.

dynamic_checks.name: Zone 0 Safety Inviolability
dynamic_checks.description: The solution must demonstrate that Zone 0 rules cannot be modified by any Loop layer, Dream Loop optimization, or self-modification mechanism
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design explicitly shows enforcement mechanism for each of the 6 Zone 0 rules. No code path, Dream Loop phase, or Skill Workshop flow can bypass Zone 0 boundaries.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: Zone 0 is the absolute safety boundary. If Dream Loop or any autonomous mechanism can modify Zone 0, the entire system becomes unsafe for 8h+ unattended operation.

dynamic_checks.name: Dead Loop Circuit Breaker
dynamic_checks.description: The solution must include a concrete mechanism to detect when the LLM is stuck in无效循环 (repeating same decisions without progress) and automatically pause
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design specifies: (1) how no-progress is detected (metric/threshold), (2) what triggers the circuit breaker, (3) what happens after pause (notification to user). Must be automatic, not manual.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: Risk R2 (LLM陷入无效循环) is high-severity. Without a circuit breaker, the system could burn tokens indefinitely without producing value, violating the 8h+ autonomous operation requirement.

dynamic_checks.name: Quality Gate Architecture
dynamic_checks.description: Quality gates must be placed at all critical nodes, using LLM-as-Judge for semantic checks and code for deterministic checks (3-layer Gate: deterministic → LLM semantic → combined decision)
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design shows: (1) where gates are placed in the Loop hierarchy, (2) what each gate evaluates, (3) LLM-as-Judge is used for semantic quality (not just string matching), (4) gates exist for sub-Agent output validation.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: Risk R3 (子Agent返回结果质量低但主Loop误判为通过) directly threatens delivery quality. Quality gates are the primary defense against cascading low-quality outputs through the fractal Loop.

dynamic_checks.name: State Persistence & Recovery
dynamic_checks.description: Loop state must survive across Sessions and be recoverable from any interruption point via pause_snapshot.json and file-as-state directory structure
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design specifies: (1) complete directory structure under memory/loops/{loop_id}/, (2) what state is persisted at each checkpoint, (3) recovery procedure from pause_snapshot.json, (4) how fractal interruption propagates across Loop layers.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: 8h+ operation guarantees Session boundaries will be crossed. Without robust state persistence, any Session termination loses all progress, making long-running operation impossible.

dynamic_checks.name: Autonomous Self-Correction Mechanism
dynamic_checks.description: LLM must proactively detect direction drift and self-correct without stopping to ask the user, per the auto_correct user directive
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design includes: (1) drift detection mechanism at critical nodes, (2) LLM-driven correction strategy (not hardcoded rules), (3) correction is logged for audit, (4) system never stops to ask user for direction confirmation.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: User explicit directive: '不希望停下来判断，大模型主动纠错'. This is a core differentiator from traditional pipelines. Without it, the system violates the fundamental user requirement.

dynamic_checks.name: Notification & Human Communication Protocol
dynamic_checks.description: Progress notifications via Feishu/UI must be throttled to max 1 per hour plus critical events, with approval items sent separately
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Design specifies: (1) hourly progress notification content and format, (2) what qualifies as 'critical event' for immediate notification, (3) approval flow (optional, default auto), (4) notification channel selection (Feishu vs desktop UI).
dynamic_checks.reasoning: User requirement: '不频繁打扰用户（最多每小时一次+关键事件）'. Important for UX but not architecturally blocking. Can be refined post-MVP.

dynamic_checks.name: Tool Integration Completeness
dynamic_checks.description: Solution must specify integration patterns for all 5 required tools: openclaw, codex_cli, hermes, claude_code, feishu
dynamic_checks.pass_criteria: Each tool has: (1) defined role in the Loop architecture, (2) integration mechanism specified, (3) first-version support confirmed for Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, Claude Code.
dynamic_checks.reasoning: User stated tool integration difficulty is low (all within existing OpenClaw capabilities). Important for completeness but not architecturally risky.

verdict_policy.rationale: This is a critical-complexity framework that will serve as the foundation for all autonomous Agent operation. warning_acceptable=false because any warning in a safety-critical framework could cascade into 8h+ of incorrect autonomous operation. min_gate_b_pass_rate=0.88 (7/8 checks must pass) ensures near-complete coverage while allowing one MINOR check to be conditional. All CRITICAL checks (6/6) must pass — no exceptions.
